# Stremio Kai in StremioZ

`portable_config/` here is [allecsc/Stremio-Kai](https://github.com/allecsc/Stremio-Kai) (GPL-3.0, see `LICENSE.md`):
- scripts, script-opts and webmods are from repo commit `a5a2a37` (2026-08-05), which is newer than the v4.8.0 release;
- `shaders/` and `fonts/` are from the v4.8.0 release archive.

Kai is the work of allecsc. If you enjoy its UI, consider supporting the author: https://ko-fi.com/allecsc

To see exactly what StremioZ changed, diff this folder against Kai at `a5a2a37`. Every edit is marked `StremioZ`.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/profile-manager.lua` | v8.6-stremioz: publishes `user-data/stremioz/motion-state` ("on", "wanted", "off") for the player's motion smoothing button.<br>v8.5-stremioz: motion smoothing. With the "motion_smoothing" setting (or `stremioz-set-motion`), AnimeJaNai gets a conf written per video (`animejanai/stremioz-motion.conf`) whose Quality/Balanced/Performance slots carry RIFE at the factor that takes the video to the display rate (at most 60 fps).<br>v8.4-stremioz: `stremioz-set-rtx-hdr` switches RTX Video HDR for the current video. Manual upscaler and RTX HDR choices are published to the web UI, which keeps them as the defaults, and saved in `cache/stremioz-defaults.json` for videos without Stremio metadata. v8.3-stremioz: a `stremioz-set-upscaler` script message switches the upscaler for the current video (preset keys, controller menu). v8.2-stremioz: the RTX Video pipeline runs AnimeJaNai on TensorRT with D3D11 frames (patched aji_trt), and "auto" picks it on any NVIDIA GPU. v8.1-stremioz added the per-session RTX Video pipeline (D3D11 + RTX Video HDR/VSR, or Vulkan), using the shell-published display HDR state. v8.0-stremioz: It is the single owner of `vf`.<br>AnimeJaNai (`@aji`, with the filter string read from mpv-animejanai.conf) is the default anime upscaler. The "upscaler" setting picks `ajn-quality` / `ajn-balanced` / `ajn-performance` / `a4k-*` / `off`.<br>SVP removed. hwdec is no longer forced; AnimeJaNai's decoder (nvdec) is kept, except Anime4K + hqdn3d, which uses copy-back.<br>Filters are cleared at file start. AnimeJaNai never runs on HDR. Legacy SD gets GPU deinterlacing.<br>If no Stremio metadata arrives within 3 s (local files), it decides from the file name. |
| `webmods/Settings/mpv-settings.js` | "Anime Upscaler" dropdown replaces "Anime4K Shaders" and the SVP toggle. "SVP for all content" and "Use Vulkan Rendering" removed. Display section adds "Video Pipeline", "RTX Video HDR" and "RTX Video Super Resolution". Stored as `stremioz-upscaler`; a Kai-era Anime4K choice migrates. "Motion Smoothing (RIFE)" toggle in Anime Enhancements (`stremioz-motion`). |
| `webmods/Metadata/Services/mpv-bridge.js` | Sends `upscaler`, `video_pipeline`, `rtx_hdr`, `rtx_vsr` and `motion_smoothing`; drops the `svp_*` and `vulkan_mode` fields. |
| `webmods/UI/welcome-wizard.js` | The anime step chooses the upscaler; SVP step removed. It welcomes to StremioZ, with the StremioZ icon; its links that support Kai are kept. |
| `webmods/Settings/custom-shortcuts.js` | AnimeJaNai keys listed; SVP keys removed. The gamepad sections describe StremioZ's controller layout. |
| `webmods/UI/Hero Banner/modules/config.js`, `cache.js`, `state.js`, `catalog-service.js`, `main.js`, `ui.js`, `HeroBanner.css` | A third banner mode, "For You" (the default), next to Kai's Movies and Anime: `catalogService.getForYou()` asks `webmods/StremioZ/hero-for-you.js` for movies and series picked from the user's watch history; its titles are cached as `heroForYouTitlesCache`. The toggle button cycles Movies → Anime → For You (`toggleCatalog(name)` picks one), and a badge names the new mode. When one source returns nothing, its slots go to the other. `modules/main.js`: titles that arrive after the 20 s first-load timeout (a first For You build, about 40 s) replace the placeholder titles at once instead of on the next launch. Kai's Movie/Series source lists are Kai's again (For You was their first entry before 0.9.3). `catalog-service.js`: when the Jikan schedule fails or takes over 8 s, `fetchAniListSchedule()` gives the same day's airing anime from AniList, shaped like Jikan's items, and Jikan is skipped for 10 minutes. |
| `webmods/UI/details-enhancer.js` | The episode list jumps to the next episode at once (`behavior: "instant"`) instead of scrolling smoothly. |
| `scripts/notify_skip/main.lua` | Order of skip sources: the file's named chapters (Intro/OP/ED…) first; then online segments (AniSkip, sent as `stremioz-aniskip` by `webmods/StremioZ/skip-sources.js`, before IntroDB); then the silence/black-frame detection. IntroDB is fetched with Windows' `curl.exe` (`http_get_json`) instead of a `python.exe` StremioZ doesn't ship. Online segments no longer replace pattern-matched chapters. Segments that start after the end of the file are dropped. An episode change after the file has loaded clears the previous episode's online skip points and puts the file's own chapter list back. |
| `webmods/Utilities/navigation.js` | The browser Gamepad API poller is off: StremioZ's native controller input (`webmods/StremioZ/tv-navigation.js`) replaces it. Keyboard navigation is unchanged. |
| removed | `svp_*.vpy`, `script-opts/svp.conf`, `scripts/svp_cleanup.lua`, `scripts/reactive_vf_bypass.lua` (SVP).<br>`webmods/UI/update-notification.*`: checks Kai's releases, not StremioZ's.<br>`webmods/UI/donation-manager.js`: Kai's donation prompt, credited above instead. |
| `mpv.conf`, `input.conf`, `stremio-settings.ini` | Kept as `*.kai-original` beside this file. The live versions are merged into `overlay/portable_config/`. |
